headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 40-166

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-5 with 1 RBI against Hayden Wesneski and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 0-for-5 against Andrew Painter and the Philadelphia Phillies. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Juan Soto connected at +400
entries.story: Juan Soto cashed. Facing Sandy Alcantara, he went deep in the 2nd in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Juan Soto homers (24) on a fly ball to center field. Francisco Alvarez scores. Francisco Lindor scores." Final line: 2-for-4 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Ben Rice stayed in the yard
entries.story: Ben Rice went 0-for-2 with 1 BB against Gabriel Hughes and the Colorado Rockies. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Teoscar Hernández came close
entries.story: Teoscar Hernández went 3-for-3 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Nick Lodolo and the Cincinnati Reds. Closest call was a triple in the 3rd: "Teoscar Hernández triples (2) on a line drive to left fielder JJ Bleday. Teoscar Hernández out at home on the throw, left fielder JJ Bleday to shortstop Elly De La Cruz to catcher Jose Trevino." The power showed up; the carry did not.
